description: Iowa Flood Center - River Stage Bridge Sensors - Rating Curves is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Rojas, Marcela (deposited on HydroShare). This Hydroshare resource contains discharge - river stage relationship (rating curves) at 285 locations in the state of Iowa where Bridge Mounted River Stage Sensors (BMRS) are installed by the Iowa Flood Center. Coverage: Iowa, United States. The resource was created 2023-11-30 and last updated 2025-07-16; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
